source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / Directorate General of Agriculture, "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean cultivation techniques], official extension manual, 2018
text: A short section on the crop's importance to Cambodia covers: contribution to household nutrition and diversifying diets away from an overreliance on a single staple (guarding against malnutrition risk described in the source as IBD, likely intending a form of dietary-deficiency-related condition per the source's own abbreviation); and rotation value — because soybean fixes atmospheric nitrogen and improves following-crop soil fertility, it is promoted as a good rotation partner ahead of cereal crops in Cambodian cropping systems.
